europe_now.title: Ukraine Peace Negotiations Resume in Abu Dhabi
europe_now.summary: Delegations have convened in Abu Dhabi for US-mediated negotiations aimed at ending the Russia-Ukraine war. Officials from multiple sides have characterized the opening discussions as constructive and productive.

sources.headline: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
US-mediated talks on ending Russia-Ukraine war begin in Abu Dhabi

europe_now.title: Iran Denies Involvement in French Supermarket Cyberattack
europe_now.summary: Tehran has formally rejected accusations that it was behind recent cyberattacks targeting supermarket refrigerators in France. Following the incident and subsequent denials, French authorities summoned the Iranian ambassador.

sources.headline: Iran denies role in fridge hack, France summons ambassador
Iran denies role in cyberattacks on French supermarket refrigerators

top_stories.title: Ukraine Peace Talks
top_stories.summary: Initial discussions in the ongoing trilateral peace negotiations have begun in Abu Dhabi. Ukrainian leadership and international observers have reported positive momentum from the opening sessions.

sources.headline: First day of Ukraine peace talks constructive, Zelensky says
US-mediated talks on ending Russia-Ukraine war begin in Abu Dhabi

top_stories.title: Cyberattack and Sabotage Response
top_stories.summary: France summoned the Iranian ambassador after denying Tehran's involvement in a digital sabotage incident affecting supermarket refrigeration systems. Meanwhile, broader European security discussions continue regarding infrastructure vulnerabilities and transit incidents.
